pages.text: Most of the machines in this mod can be upgraded in various ways. On the next pages you will see what machine accepts what upgrade and what it does. The upgrade slots of the machines is the column of 4 pink-ish slots in the corner of the gui.

pages.title: Capacity
pages.text: Capacity upgrades increase the max soul capacity of machines. They work in:$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_core)Soul Core$(/l)

pages.title: Transfer Amount
pages.text: Transfer amount upgrades increase the amount of souls sent per packet. They work in:$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_core)Soul Core$(/l)

pages.title: Transfer Rate
pages.text: Transfer amount upgrades increase the rate of sending packets. They work in:$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_core)Soul Core$(/l)$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_crafter)Soul Crafter$(/l) - increase the speed of crafting.

pages.title: Soul Efficiency
pages.text: Efficiency upgrades affect the number of souls used/gained. They work in:$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_furnace)Soul Furnace$(/l) - decrease soul used per item and momentum decay rate.$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_crucible)Soul Crucible$(/l) - increase souls gained per item. $(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_crafter)Soul Crafter$(/l) - decrease souls used for crafting.

pages.title: Smelt Speed
pages.text: Smelt speed upgrades increase the smelting speed. They work in:$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_furnace)Soul Furnace$(/l) - increase max momentum and momentum gain.$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_crucible)Soul Crucible$(/l)

pages.title: Smelt Amount
pages.text: Smelt amount upgrades increase the amount of smelted items. They work in:$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_furnace)Soul Furnace$(/l) - also increase soul cost per item.$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_crucible)Soul Crucible$(/l)

pages.title: Overload
pages.text: This upgrade is the most $(#F0F)powerful$() of all in the mod. It is really overpowered, but has some negative effects. It works in:$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_core)Soul Core$(/l) - overloads the cores max capacity. Can make the core $(l:shadowthings:core_meltdown)$(#F00)EXPLODE$()

$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_furnace)Soul Furnace$(/l) - increases max momentum to insane amounts. [NO NEGATIVE EFFECTS FOR NOW]$(li)$(l:shadowthings:soul_crafter)Soul Crafter$(/l) - unlocks overpowered recipes. $(#F00)[NOT IMPLEMENTED YET]$()
